name: Income and spending
prompt: Design a full-bleed 1440px wide (landscape 3:2) desktop screenshot of real polished software, phooey! finance, a finance dashboard for a solopreneur. This revision absolutely requires compact modern sans-serif typography everywhere (Geist or similar), a restrained 24px heading, tabular numbers, a graph-led screen with a real tool strip and data density. Light warm neutral background, rich deep green ink #173C35, muted burnt-orange expense series #BD522D, jade net series. Actual user chrome, no marketing, no eyebrows or ornamental labels, no fake growth badges, no bank logos. Use existing lowercase round bold "phooey!" wordmark. Operational navigation must include Overview, Transactions, Reports, Accounts, Invoicer and Settings. Use fictional figures: period income $48,600, expenses $16,240, net $32,360. Add transaction, reporting period, currency (USD), graph style selector and a graph/table view toggle. All controls that appear must make sense. Typography should look like a meticulously typeset contemporary web app at 100% zoom. Full app viewport; no outer frame. Slim warm-white top navigation with forest green wordmark and active underline. Page title and filter bar share one row. Primary composition is two equal adjacent square plots with a shared time axis: left a densely sampled green income column chart and right a rust expenses column chart; each plot has a compact anchored total. Net income rides in a separate narrow full-width band just under the plots. Lower third is full-width detailed transaction register. Emphasize paired graphs, symmetrical alignment and compact filters; only normal readable headers, no tagline or descriptive text. Controls sit right on a single utility bar.
